decisions.summary: Declared platform is web-companion (mobile-first web app); native build is an explicit non-goal for this phase
Domain logic extracted to framework-independent module per POL-PORTABLE-019
In-process fixed-window rate limiter; move to shared store if multi-instance
Dual-runtime data facade: pg mode (DATABASE_URL) vs supabase mode (SUPABASE_URL+SERVICE_ROLE_KEY); realtime = SSE on Node, Supabase Realtime WebSockets on Workers
Cloudflare Workers deploy via OpenNext; Next upgraded 16.3.1->16.3.4 to satisfy adapter peer range
Option A adopted: backend-free architecture. Static SPA + data.json rebuilt daily by GitHub Action (live verification preserved). Server/Supabase editions remain in repo as optional.
